answer: An attester must stake 26% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the dawn stake is held until the forge settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the echo audit lists each exposure. A farm running 140 keys thus forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
